name: What is a garage-to-rental-unit conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage-to-rental-unit conversion transforms an existing garage into a habitable living space, often an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU). This typically involves adding plumbing for a bathroom and kitchen, electrical upgrades, insulation, windows, and an independent entrance. The goal is to create a self-contained unit that can be rented out, providing additional income or housing for family members. Conversions must comply with local zoning and building codes to ensure safety and legality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage-to-rental-unit conversion transforms a garage into a habitable, self-contained living space, often an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), for rental income or family housing.
